Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full quote-builder payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Configure your quote","product":"TB-9000 Assembly Cell","currency":"USD","basePrice":48000,"optionGroups":[{"id":"material","label":"Frame material","selectedId":"steel","options":[{"id":"steel","label":"Powder-coated steel","priceDelta":0},{"id":"stainless","label":"Stainless 304","priceDelta":3200,"detail":"Washdown-rated"}]},{"id":"controls","label":"Control package","options":[{"id":"standard","label":"Standard PLC","priceDelta":0},{"id":"advanced","label":"Advanced PLC + HMI","priceDelta":5400}]},{"id":"warranty","label":"Warranty","options":[{"id":"1yr","label":"1 year","priceDelta":0},{"id":"3yr","label":"3 years","priceDelta":2600}]}],"quantity":1,"submitText":"Request quote","submitValue":"Request a formal quote for the configured TB-9000 Assembly Cell"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Configure your quote'. - 'product' (string, optional): the product being configured. - 'currency' (string, optional): ISO code (default USD). Prices are shown with no cents. - 'basePrice' (number, optional): the starting price before options. The live estimate is (basePrice + sum of selected option priceDeltas) × quantity. - 'optionGroups' (array, REQUIRED, 1 to 5 objects): each has 'id' (string), 'label' (string, REQUIRED), optional 'selectedId' (the option 'id' chosen by default — defaults to the first option), and 'options' (array, 2+ objects). Each option has 'id' (string, REQUIRED), 'label' (string, REQUIRED), optional 'priceDelta' (number, added to the price; 0 shows as 'Included'), and 'detail' (string, one short line). Exactly one option per group is selected at a time. - 'quantity' (number, optional): starting quantity (min 1); the customer adjusts it with the stepper. - 'minQuantity' (number, optional): minimum quantity (default 1). - 'submitText' (string, optional): action-button label; defaults to 'Request quote'. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): a base message; the card appends the chosen options, quantity, and estimated total when sending back. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
